Resources for Faculty and Staff

Temple University’s Office of Corporate and Foundation Relations (CFR) helps faculty and staff pursue foundation and/or corporate support on both regional and national levels. Faculty and program directors should work with their school’s or college's development team to notify CFR of potential proposals or organizational partnerships. For additional information, please contact the Office of CFR to discuss potential proposals or organizational partnerships.

Current Funding Opportunities

The Office of Corporate and Foundation Relations (CFR) regularly curates Requests for Proposal opportunities from corporations and foundations.

  • Opportunities are organized by deadline.
  • To search for an opportunity that is pertinent to your research, please select “Ctrl + F” on your keyboard and type your keywords in the box.
  • Due dates that include an asterisk (*) indicate the anticipated due date based on previous year deadlines.

Please note Limited Submissions must go through an internal approval process by the Office of the Vice President for Research. If you have any questions, reach out to CFR staff.

  • View Upcoming Funding Deadlines
Funding Resources

Pivot

Pivot includes information about sponsors in many disciplines, as well as federal, nonfederal and international sponsors. Temple faculty can search funding opportunities and access services such as targeted funding opportunity alerts and an expertise database. Sign up to access services with your Temple credentials.

Philanthropy News Digest by Candid

Philanthropy News Digest publishes requests for proposals (RFPs) and notices of awards as a free service for U.S.-based nonprofit organizations. View, search and sign up for RFP alerts delivered to your inbox.

Grants Learning Center

The Graduate School has partnered with OVPR to manage the Hanover Research Grants Learning Center, which provides exclusive access to Temple faculty through a self-paced training platform designed to help develop competitive grant proposals.
